summary: Build ISO/IEC 27033 network security management skills and prepare for the PECB exam with this five-day certification course.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who shape, implement, oversee, or advise on network security using the ISO/IEC 27033 series.
prerequisites: PECB lists a fundamental understanding of the ISO/IEC 27033 series and general knowledge of network security concepts as the main participation requirement.
